# Vanway Kitchen + Bath

> > Custom cabinet maker and countertop specialist serving northern British Columbia since 1981, with showrooms in Terrace and Prince George.

Vanway Kitchen + Bath designs and manufactures custom kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, and quartz countertops for residential and commercial clients throughout northern BC. Known for quality craftsmanship, personalized design consultations, and strong relationships with contractors and homeowners across the region.

## Key Topics

- Custom kitchen cabinets
- Quartz countertops
- Bathroom vanities
- Northern BC cabinet maker
- Terrace showroom
- Prince George showroom
- Design consultation
- Shaker cabinet doors
- Wood species and finishes
- Commercial cabinetry
- Contractor partnerships
- Stone countertops
- Customer testimonials
- Since 1981
